title: Chapter 4 — Subfloor 4, and out
description: Chapter 4, and a pass over everything that could leave you stuck. The timed gate under Subfloor 4 was asking for a 22 metre run on a 5.2 second clock, which is not a run — it is a wall with a countdown on it. Nothing that moves closes around you any more, and dying deep in a long stretch no longer costs you the whole stretch.
changelog: Fixed: the timed gate on Subfloor 4 could not be beaten at all — 22 metres and three obstacles on a 5.2 second clock, when a flat sprint alone takes 5.1. It is 9 seconds now.
Fixed: gates and doors no longer close on you. Stand in one and it waits.
Fixed: a gate that looked open was still solid for half a second, and turned solid again within a frame of the clock ending while still drawn wide open
Fixed: the counterweighted deck came down on top of you and sealed you inside it — it stands you on itself now
Fixed: Chapter 3's duct gave 26 seconds for a crawl that takes 23. It gives 34.
Many more checkpoints: every corridor in Chapters 3 and 4 is now a place you come back to, so a death fifty rooms into Subfloor 4 costs you a room instead of the whole run
Checkpoints survive quitting, so resuming puts you where you actually got to
Chapter 4 — Subfloor 4: 79 rooms, ten puzzles solved by moving, three bolts, and the way out
Chases rebuilt across every chapter: the pursuit walks its own route at its own speed instead of being pinned to you
notes: A signed release build, not a debug one. Installs over any earlier build and keeps every world; every release is signed with the same key so updates never need an uninstall.
